spec.expr:
label_replace(
  label_replace(
  min_over_time(
    weather:temperature:celsius{job=~"$job", placement="outdoor" , reference="true"}[$__range]
  ),
  "stat", "day_min", "job", ".*"
),
  "field", "temperature", "job", ".*"
)
or
label_replace(
  label_replace(
  min_over_time(
    weather:relative_humidity:percent{job=~"$job", placement="outdoor", reference="true"}[$__range]
  ),
  "stat", "day_min", "job", ".*"
),
  "field", "humidity", "job", ".*"
)
or
label_replace(
  label_replace(
  min_over_time(
    weather:pressure:hPa{job=~"$job", placement="outdoor", reference="true"}[$__range]
  ),
  "stat", "day_min", "job", ".*"
),
  "field", "pressure", "job", ".*"
)
or
label_replace(
  label_replace(
  min_over_time(
    weather:illuminance:lux{job=~"$job", placement="outdoor", reference="true"}[$__range]
  ),
  "stat", "day_min", "job", ".*"
),
  "field", "illuminance", "job", ".*"
)

    weather:temperature:celsius{job=~"$job", placement="outdoor", reference="true"}[$__range]
  ),
  "stat", "day_max", "job", ".*"
),
  "field", "temperature", "job", ".*"

or
label_replace(
  label_replace(
  max_over_time(
    weather:relative_humidity:percent{job=~"$job", placement="outdoor", reference="true"}[$__range]
  ),
  "stat", "day_max", "job", ".*"
),
  "field", "humidity", "job", ".*"
)
or
label_replace(
  label_replace(
  max_over_time(
    weather:pressure:hPa{job=~"$job", placement="outdoor", reference="true"}[$__range]
  ),
  "stat", "day_max", "job", ".*"
),
  "field", "pressure", "job", ".*"

or
label_replace(
  label_replace(
  max_over_time(
    weather:illuminance:lux{job=~"$job", placement="outdoor", reference="true"}[$__range]
  ),
  "stat", "day_max", "job", ".*"
),
  "field", "illuminance", "job", ".*"
)

(
  sum(
    50 *
    clamp_max(clamp_min(-delta(weather:pressure:hPa{job=~"$job",  placement="outdoor", reference="true"}[3h]), 0), 4) / 4
  ) or vector(0)
)
+
(
  sum(
    20 *
    clamp_max(clamp_min(delta(weather:relative_humidity:percent{job=~"$job",  placement="outdoor", reference="true"}[3h]), 0), 20) / 20
  ) or vector(0)
)
+
(
  sum(
    20 *
    clamp_max(clamp_min(-delta(weather:temperature:celsius{job=~"$job",  placement="outdoor", reference="true"}[3h]), 0), 5) / 5
  ) or vector(0)
)
+
(
  sum(
    10 *
    clamp_max(stddev_over_time(weather:pressure:hPa{job=~"$job",  placement="outdoor", reference="true"}[30m]), 0.8) / 0.8
  ) or vector(0)
)

spec.expr:
(weather:temperature:celsius{job=~"$job", placement="indoor", reference="true"} + 273 ) 
/ on()
(
  (weather:temperature:celsius{job=~"$job", placement="indoor", reference="true"} 
  - on()
  weather:temperature:celsius{job=~"$job",  placement="outdoor", reference="true"}) 
  + 
  0.001
)

(esp32_sensor_mean_60s{job=~"$job", placement="indoor", reference="true",  sensor="bme280", field="temperature"} + 273 ) 
/ on()
(
  (esp32_sensor_mean_60s{job=~"$job", placement="indoor", reference="true", sensor="bme280", field="temperature"} 
  - on()
  esp32_sensor_mean_60s{job=~"$job", placement="outdoor", reference="true", sensor="bme280", field="temperature"}) 
  + 
  0.001
)

spec.title: Outdoor Air State — Temperature vs Absolute Humidity
spec.description:
Outdoor air state plotted against psychrometric reference curves. 
Horizontal movement mostly indicates heating/cooling of the same air mass.
Vertical movement indicates moistening or drying.
